title: 3Sum Closest
statement: Return the sum of three integers in `nums` that is closest to `target`. Each input has exactly one closest sum.
hints: Sort, then the same two-pointer walk used for 3Sum can track distance instead of equality.
If the current sum is smaller than the target, move the left pointer. If it is larger, move the right pointer.
Keep the sum whose absolute difference from the target is smallest.

approaches.name: Sort plus two pointers
approaches.explanation: Prune the inner search with sorted order.

editorial: After sorting, fix one index and move two pointers. The sum moves monotonically as a pointer moves, so you never need to restart the inner scan. Update the best sum whenever the absolute error improves, and stop early if you hit the target exactly.
